data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were 3,077.2 (statement of financial position). The report does not disclose an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement (prior-year development) figure. The gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2016 were 3,053.1 (a net reduction of 24.1 over the year), but the technical provisions note shows a positive movement in the provision of 23.3 and exchange adjustments of (47.4), so the report does not isolate a gross prioryear development amount. No specific named prior-year reserve adjustments or quantified gross PYD are stated.
raw_causal_phrases: The most critical estimate included within the syndicate's financial position is the estimate for losses incurred but not reported.
The IBNR amount is based on estimates calculated using widely accepted statistical techniques (e.g. chain ladder) which are reviewed annually by external consulting actuaries.
The provision for claims comprises amounts set aside for claims advised and IBNR.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year development (PYD) figure for claims outstanding was presented in the report. The technical provisions reconciliation shows overall gross claims movements and exchange adjustments (movement in provision 23.3; exchange adjustments (47.4)) but does not isolate PYD. No claims development triangle or 'movement in prior years' gross column was available in the provided text. Hence prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null.
